mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 4.0% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days as investor sentiment shifts toward slower economic growth and tighter labor markets.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) despite UNRATE exceeding 4.0% in the next month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) indices signals a balanced economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite both GDPC1 and INDPRO rising.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained decline in the federal funds rate predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate lower interest rates boosting equity valuations.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion regimes, 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite FEDFUNDS declining.

mechanism_narrative: Continued growth in employment (PAYEMS) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days as strong labor market conditions boost consumer confidence and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite PAYEMS rising.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in the unemployment rate below 2.0% triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days as investors anticipate tighter labor markets and higher wage growth.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite UNRATE falling below 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate coupled with rising demand (GDPC1) signals an expansionary monetary policy and stronger economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite FEDFUNDS declining and GDPC1 rising.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, a sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 1.5% predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days as investors anticipate prolonged easing and economic stabilization.
failure_condition: In post-shock recovery regimes, 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite FEDFUNDS declining below 1.5%.
